title: Text: DET Dan Griesbaum ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Got an interesting e-mail this morning
A husband with a fake name, relaying all this Chris granger dirt lol
Really? Like Chris was sleeping w his wife kinda deal?
No just how he runs things
His wife works in the ticket dept

Interesting. In fairness, the practice of not telling employees their commission percentage until after the sales season is over has actually been a common practice for years there. It’s very very shady but I wouldn’t put that on Granger solely. I don’t know if “fear” is the right word for him but I believe he tried the wizard of Oz routine. To this day, he has yet to address the Tigers organization as a group. Can you imagine being named the president of a team and not addressing them for years?
Yes, I’m taking it with a little more than a grain of salt, just thought it was interesting. What exactly do you mean by that, “addressing”

I just mean he was hired to run the operation and never talked to the group. He spoke to department heads of course and other employees when needed but he seemed to want to be in the shadows. If there’s any story anywhere I think the firing or nudging aside of the ticket sales management of both teams is a story.  The wings sales have been excellent by all measures in both arenas and the Tigers sales were excellent when they should have been excellent. The downturn is certainly no fault of Steve Fox or Scot Pett.
